ns2:section.sectionText: There will be opportunities for synchronous office hours through Zoom. For exams, students will have a choice between using the online testing services ProctorU, Proctorio, or a free lab on-campus. The three midterm exams are 1 hour each and the final is 2 hours. Information on ProctorU can be found here https://online.illinois.edu/proctoru Information on Proctorio can be found here https://proctorio.com/about. This course will use Moodle.
